opportunities.title: Establish one canonical entity/fact source and propagate it
opportunities.summary: Decide which value is current and correct.
opportunities.description: Findings from freshness-corroboration-audit and structured-data-entity-audit co-occur on overlapping pages: FRC.COPYRIGHT_YEAR_LAG, SDE.BREADCRUMB_MISSING, SDE.NO_STRUCTURED_DATA.
opportunities.rationale: Both detectors independently flagged overlapping pages (https://books.toscrape.com/, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/1000-places-to-see-before-you-die_1/index.html, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/add-a-comment_18/index.html), which is stronger evidence of a compound, template-level problem than either finding alone.
opportunities.scope: Observed across 10 overlapping sampled page(s): https://books.toscrape.com/, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/1000-places-to-see-before-you-die_1/index.html, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/add-a-comment_18/index.html (and more)
opportunities.mechanism: A fact contradicted across the site's own pages, alongside structured data that does not agree with itself either, means there is no single version of this fact a machine could trust even if it wanted to.
opportunities.expected_effect: Every surface stating this fact, structured or visible, states the same current value.
recommended_actions: Decide which value is current and correct.
Update every surface named in the underlying findings to match it, and reference a single source (a stable @id, or one field) going forward rather than maintaining separate copies.
opportunities.verification: Re-run the audit against the URLs named in scope and confirm none of FRC.COPYRIGHT_YEAR_LAG, SDE.BREADCRUMB_MISSING, SDE.NO_STRUCTURED_DATA fire again.

opportunities.title: Treat access and render problems on the same template as one compound gate
opportunities.summary: Confirm both issues affect the same template cluster, not merely the same site.
opportunities.description: Findings from crawl-access-audit and render-readability-audit co-occur on overlapping pages: ACC.CANONICAL_MISSING, RND.HEADING_LEVEL_JUMPS.
opportunities.rationale: Both detectors independently flagged overlapping pages (https://books.toscrape.com/, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/1000-places-to-see-before-you-die_1/index.html, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/add-a-comment_18/index.html), which is stronger evidence of a compound, template-level problem than either finding alone.
opportunities.scope: Observed across 10 overlapping sampled page(s): https://books.toscrape.com/, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/1000-places-to-see-before-you-die_1/index.html, https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/add-a-comment_18/index.html (and more)
opportunities.mechanism: A page an agent cannot reach and a page it can reach but cannot read are two different symptoms of the same outcome: the content never reaches an answer. Fixing access without fixing render, or the reverse, still leaves the gate shut.
opportunities.expected_effect: Once both are addressed on the same template, the pages in that cluster stop failing at either the accessible or the readable gate.
recommended_actions: Confirm both issues affect the same template cluster, not merely the same site.
Sequence the access fix first, since a render fix cannot be verified by an agent that cannot reach the page at all.
Re-run the audit against representative URLs from the cluster after both changes ship.
opportunities.verification: Re-run the audit against the URLs named in scope and confirm none of ACC.CANONICAL_MISSING, RND.HEADING_LEVEL_JUMPS fire again.

tracks.what: Whether the brand is named, and cited, in assistant answers to category, brand-direct, comparison and long-tail questions
tracks.how: A fixed panel of 30 to 50 prompts, run across several assistants in clean sessions, several repeats each; record the rate the brand is named and cited, not a single outcome

tracks.what: Whether the agents that matter are actually reaching the site
tracks.how: Server-log monitoring of crawler activity (request counts, status codes and paths per agent), verified against each operator's published address ranges rather than the user-agent header alone

tracks.what: Whether the current version of each canonical fact is the one that exists in the world
tracks.how: For each canonical fact, check independent sources state the current value; alert when a superseded version resurfaces

tracks.what: Whether the fixes from this audit held
tracks.how: Re-run this audit on a schedule and diff the reports by check_id: resolved, new, regressed

tracks.what: Whether representative high-value pages continue to expose an observable next step
tracks.how: Re-run the engagement check on a schedule against the same sampled page set and diff by check_id

measurement_plan.caveat: Assistants personalise: two people asking the same question can get different brands and framing. A single prompt on a single day is not a measurement. Run clean sessions, repeat each prompt, and report rates with the sample size attached. The report carries a stable check_id on every finding precisely so consecutive audits can be diffed; the sequential id shifts as findings are added or resolved, check_id does not.
